instructions.name: append_contribution
docs: Append a child contribution under an existing node. Parent account is
strictly read-only: children are alternative branches, not
withdrawals from a shared balance (docs/04).

accounts.name: parent
docs: Economic parent: program-owned, same project, FINALIZED.
Read-only — sibling appends never touch parent economic state.

accounts.name: node
docs: `mut` required: the account is allocated via CPI on first creation.

accounts.name: contributor
docs: Must equal intent.contributor (native signer == contributor).

accounts.name: controller
docs: Required iff project.extension_policy == REVIEWED; must equal
project.controller. Pass the program id (None) under OPEN.

instructions.name: create_project
docs: Create an immutable project. The network domain is committed from the
deployment config; rule, capacity and policy are fixed for v1.
Re-running with the same nonce AND identical parameters is idempotent;
the same nonce with different parameters is rejected.

accounts.name: project
docs: `mut` required: the account is allocated via CPI on first creation.

instructions.name: initialize_deployment
docs: One-time immutable deployment configuration: commits the target
cluster genesis hash (the intent `network_genesis` domain). Programs
cannot read the genesis hash from a sysvar, so the reviewed value is
committed here once (docs/14 "Network binding"). Re-running with the
same parameters is idempotent; conflicting parameters are rejected.

accounts.name: config
docs: the handler manually creates it or performs an idempotent compare.
`mut` required: the account is allocated via CPI on first creation.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Recorded as config.authority; confers no power in v1.

instructions.name: publish_root
docs: Publish the unique project root (residual_in = U, depth 0).
Signer must be the project creator and intent.contributor.

accounts.name: node
docs: `mut` required: the account is allocated via CPI on first creation.

accounts.name: contributor
docs: Must equal project.creator and intent.contributor.

errors.name: NetworkMismatch
errors.msg: network_genesis does not match the project's committed deployment domain

errors.name: ProgramMismatch
errors.msg: program_id does not match the executing program

errors.name: ProjectMismatch
errors.msg: project_address does not match the supplied project account

errors.name: SignerMismatch
errors.msg: intent contributor must equal the native transaction signer

errors.name: TermsMismatch
errors.msg: terms_sha256 must equal the project's immutable master terms digest

errors.name: NameOutOfRange
errors.msg: name must be 1..=64 UTF-8 bytes

errors.name: TitleOutOfRange
errors.msg: title must be <= 96 UTF-8 bytes

errors.name: ReferencesOutOfRange
errors.msg: references allows at most 8 entries

errors.name: InvalidCustodyMode
errors.msg: custody_mode must be 1 (user), 2 (embedded) or 3 (server)

errors.name: ClaimOutOfRange
errors.msg: claim_bps must be an integer in 0..=10000

errors.name: ResidualOutOfRange
errors.msg: residual_in outside 0..=U

errors.name: BranchCapacityExhausted
errors.msg: positive claim on a fully consumed residual

errors.name: ClaimRoundsToZero
errors.msg: positive claim rounds to zero effective units

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: checked arithmetic overflow

errors.name: AccountNotFresh
errors.msg: PDA account is not owned by the system program or is not empty

errors.name: InvalidPda
errors.msg: PDA seeds do not derive the supplied account address

errors.name: NonceReuseMismatch
errors.msg: nonce already used with a different intent digest (replay with identical intent is idempotent)

errors.name: ProjectConflict
errors.msg: project PDA already exists with different parameters

errors.name: DeploymentConflict
errors.msg: deployment config PDA already exists with different parameters

errors.name: RootMustHaveNoParent
errors.msg: publish_root intents must carry economic_parent = none

errors.name: ProjectRootExists
errors.msg: project root node already set

errors.name: CreatorRequired
errors.msg: publish_root signer must be the project creator

errors.name: ParentMismatch
errors.msg: intent.economic_parent must equal the supplied parent account

errors.name: ParentProjectMismatch
errors.msg: parent node belongs to a different project

errors.name: ParentNotAppendable
errors.msg: parent node is not in an appendable state

errors.name: ParentNotCanonicalPda
errors.msg: parent address is not the canonical node PDA for its stored project/contributor/nonce

errors.name: DepthOutOfRange
errors.msg: resulting depth would exceed MAX_DEPTH (1024)

errors.name: ControllerConsentRequired
errors.msg: REVIEWED project requires the recorded controller to co-sign

errors.name: ControllerMismatch
errors.msg: supplied controller does not match project.controller

errors.name: InvalidExtensionPolicy
errors.msg: invalid extension policy; expected 1 (OPEN) or 2 (REVIEWED)

errors.name: MissingController
errors.msg: REVIEWED policy requires a non-null controller key

errors.name: InvalidGenesis
errors.msg: network_genesis must be a real genesis hash (non-zero)

errors.name: ProjectTitleOutOfRange
errors.msg: project title must be <= 96 UTF-8 bytes

types.name: ContributionNode
docs: Immutable finalized contribution node. Never mutated, never closed.
All seven economic fields are stored per docs/01 ("validated caches").

fields.name: state_version
docs: Layout/state version; always 1.

fields.name: economic_rule
docs: Economic rule id; 1 = "residual-v1".

fields.name: node_state
docs: Node lifecycle state; 1 = FINALIZED (the only on-chain state in v1 —
restricted/disputed are application annotations, never chain state).

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical PDA bump.

fields.name: depth
docs: parent.depth + 1; root depth 0; bound MAX_DEPTH = 1024.

fields.name: claim_bps
docs: Claimed basis points of the incoming residual, 0..=10000.

fields.name: custody_mode
docs: Disclosed signing context; 1 user, 2 embedded, 3 server.

fields.name: project
docs: Owning project.

fields.name: economic_parent
docs: Single economic parent; None for the project root.

fields.name: contributor
docs: Native signer and beneficiary (v1 beneficiary == contributor).

fields.name: references
docs: Non-economic descriptive ancestry refs (<= 8).

fields.name: nonce
docs: 16-byte contribution nonce (also a PDA seed).

fields.name: name
docs: Self-chosen label (1..=64 UTF-8 bytes).

fields.name: title
docs: Artifact label (<= 96 UTF-8 bytes).

fields.name: intent_digest
docs: SHA-256 of the IntentV1 wire bytes, recomputed on-chain.

fields.name: terms_sha256
docs: Must equal project.terms_sha256.

fields.name: declared_at
docs: Untrusted client-declared time.

fields.name: observed_slot
docs: Network-observed slot / unix time.

fields.name: project_nonce
docs: 16-byte PDA nonce; seeds ["tessera_project", creator, nonce].

fields.name: title
docs: <= 96 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: terms_sha256
docs: Project master contribution-agreement digest.

fields.name: extension_policy
docs: 1 = OPEN, 2 = REVIEWED.

fields.name: controller
docs: Required when extension_policy == REVIEWED.

types.name: DeploymentConfig
docs: One-time immutable deployment configuration. The program cannot read the
cluster genesis hash on-chain (no sysvar exposes it), so each deployment
commits its reviewed network-domain value here exactly once
(docs/14 "Network binding" — "constant or configuration").

fields.name: state_version
docs: Layout/state version; always 1 for v1.

fields.name: network_genesis
docs: Target cluster genesis hash — the intent `network_genesis` domain.

fields.name: program_id
docs: Program id committed at init; always == the executing program.

fields.name: authority
docs: The authority that ran initialize_deployment. Recorded for
transparency; grants no mutation or admin power in v1.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical PDA bump for ["tessera_config"].

types.name: IntentV1Fields
docs: The complete semantic IntentV1 fields carried as instruction arguments.
`format_version`, `statement_code` and the domain separator are fixed v1
constants and are not repeated as arguments.

fields.name: network_genesis
docs: Target network domain (deployment genesis hash).

fields.name: program_id
docs: Must equal the executing program id.

fields.name: project_address
docs: Must equal the project account address.

fields.name: economic_parent
docs: Economic parent node; None iff publish_root.

fields.name: references
docs: Non-economic descriptive ancestry refs, 0..=8.

fields.name: nonce
docs: 16-byte CSPRNG uniqueness/idempotency nonce (PDA seed).

fields.name: contributor
docs: Must equal the native transaction signer (and beneficiary in v1).

fields.name: name
docs: 1..=64 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: title
docs: 0..=96 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: terms_sha256
docs: Must equal the project's master terms digest.

fields.name: declared_at
docs: Untrusted client-declared Unix time.

fields.name: custody_mode
docs: 1 user, 2 embedded, 3 server.

types.name: NodeReplayed
docs: Emitted when a republished intent maps onto an already-existing node
(identical digest): the transaction succeeds without changing state.

types.name: ProjectAccount
docs: Immutable project scope. Extension policy and terms are fixed at creation;
`root_node` is set exactly once by publish_root.

fields.name: state_version
docs: Layout/state version; always 1.

fields.name: economic_rule
docs: Economic rule id; 1 = "residual-v1".

fields.name: extension_policy
docs: Extension policy; 1 = OPEN, 2 = REVIEWED.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical PDA bump.

fields.name: network_genesis
docs: Committed deployment network domain (copied from DeploymentConfig).

fields.name: program_id
docs: Always == the executing program id.

fields.name: creator
docs: Project creator; the only key allowed to publish the root.

fields.name: controller
docs: REVIEWED co-signer. Inert under OPEN.

fields.name: root_node
docs: The unique root node; set once by publish_root, never changed.

fields.name: project_nonce
docs: 16-byte PDA nonce supplied at creation (also a PDA seed).

fields.name: title
docs: Bounded project label (<= 96 UTF-8 bytes).

fields.name: terms_sha256
docs: Project master contribution-agreement digest; every child intent must
carry this exact value in terms_sha256.

fields.name: total_units
docs: Total capacity U = 1_000_000_000_000.

fields.name: created_slot
docs: Network-observed creation slot / unix time (not client-asserted).
